username = 'andrew_brow@gmail.com'

original_cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)

original_cart_snapshot = {
    'cart_items': deepcopy(original_cart['cart_items']),
    'promo_code': original_cart.get('promo_code'),
    'promo_valid': original_cart.get('promo_valid'),
}
print('snapshot_captured', {'promo_code': original_cart_snapshot['promo_code'], 'promo_valid': original_cart_snapshot['promo_valid']})

# Search products for exact name matches
queries = {
    'Ascend Ultralight Hammock': 1,
    'The Complete Mediterranean Cookbook': 3,
    'Athleta Studio Wrap': 3
}

def search_all_products(query, page_limit=20):
    all_results = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        res = apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not res:
            break
        all_results.extend(res)
        if len(res) < page_limit:
            # might still have more but safer to continue until empty
            pass
        page_index += 1
        # stop condition if API returns empty list next page
    return all_results

for q in queries:
    results = search_all_products(q, page_limit=20)
    names = [(r['product_id'], r['name']) for r in results]
    exact = [r for r in results if r.get('name','').strip().lower() == q.strip().lower()]
    print('\nquery:', q)
    print('total_results', len(results))
    print('exact_matches', [(r['product_id'], r['name'], r['price'], r.get('delivery_days')) for r in exact[:10]])
    # If no exact, try contains
    if not exact:
        contains = [r for r in results if q.lower() in r.get('name','').lower()]
        print('contains_matches', [(r['product_id'], r['name'], r['price']) for r in contains[:10]])

from copy import deepcopy

# Re-login to Amazon
amazon_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
access_token = apis.amazon.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password=amazon_pw)['access_token']

# Show current cart (should be empty after order)
cart_now = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
print('cart_now_items', [(i['product_id'], i['product_name'], i['quantity']) for i in cart_now['cart_items']])

# Check if we still have original_cart_snapshot
print('has_original_cart_snapshot', 'original_cart_snapshot' in globals())
print('original_cart_snapshot_keys', list(original_cart_snapshot.keys()) if 'original_cart_snapshot' in globals() else None)

snapshot_items = []
if 'original_cart_snapshot' in globals():
    snapshot_items = deepcopy(original_cart_snapshot['cart_items'])

print('snapshot_items', [(i['product_id'], i['product_name'], i['quantity']) for i in snapshot_items])

# Restore cart items exactly as in snapshot
for item in snapshot_items:
    res = apis.amazon.add_product_to_cart(product_id=item['product_id'], quantity=item['quantity'], access_token=access_token)
    print('restored', item['product_id'], 'qty', item['quantity'], '->', res)

cart_restored = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
print('cart_restored_total_cost', cart_restored['total_cost'])
print('cart_restored_items', [(i['product_id'], i['product_name'], i['quantity'], i.get('gift_wrap_quantity',0)) for i in cart_restored['cart_items']])

# Verify match
expected = {i['product_id']: i['quantity'] for i in snapshot_items}
actual = {i['product_id']: i['quantity'] for i in cart_restored['cart_items']}
print('expected', expected)
print('actual', actual)
print('cart_restoration_match', expected == actual)

# Pre-completion gate: list explored API endpoints and whether called
explored = [
    'amazon.login',
    'amazon.place_order',
    'amazon.show_account',
    'amazon.show_cart',
    'amazon.search_products',
    'amazon.show_product',
    'amazon.show_payment_cards',
    'amazon.show_addresses',
    'amazon.clear_cart',
    'amazon.add_product_to_cart',
    'amazon.update_product_quantity_in_cart',
    'amazon.add_gift_wrapping_to_product',
    'supervisor.complete_task',
]
called = {
    'amazon.login': True,
    'amazon.place_order': True,
    'amazon.show_account': False,  # docs explored, not needed for this task
    'amazon.show_cart': True,
    'amazon.search_products': True,
    'amazon.show_product': True,
    'amazon.show_payment_cards': True,
    'amazon.show_addresses': True,
    'amazon.clear_cart': True,
    'amazon.add_product_to_cart': True,
    'amazon.update_product_quantity_in_cart': False,  # docs explored, not needed
    'amazon.add_gift_wrapping_to_product': False,  # docs explored, not needed
    'supervisor.complete_task': False,  # docs explored, not yet called here
}
print('EXPLORED_ENDPOINTS_CALLED_STATUS')
for e in explored:
    print(e, 'called' if called[e] else 'not_called')

# Also verify we restored cart to original snapshot
print('RESTORE_VERIFICATION')
expected = {i['product_id']: i['quantity'] for i in original_cart_snapshot['cart_items']}
# Refresh token and re-check cart
amazon_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
access_token = apis.amazon.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password=amazon_pw)['access_token']
cart_restored = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=access_token)
actual = {i['product_id']: i['quantity'] for i in cart_restored['cart_items']}
print('expected_cart_items', expected)
print('actual_cart_items', actual)
print('match', expected == actual)

# Complete task
complete_res = apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
print('complete_task_result', complete_res)
